artworks.title: Auch ein Todtentanz: Text Page
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a printed poem. The poem is presented on an off-white page with two distinct blocks of text written in a decorative, serifed typeface. The text is aligned to form two columns, with the first column on the left side of the page and the second column on the right. Each line begins with a capital letter, and some words are emphasized with italics. The surface of the page shows subtle signs of age, such as small spots and slight discoloration. The overall aesthetic of the document is one of literary significance and formality.

artworks.title: Hurdy-Gurdy Player in a Tall Hat
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing the upper half of a person's body. The person is positioned slightly facing towards the right side of the image, with their head tilted downwards. Their facial features are heavily shadowed; they have a prominent nose and chin. They are wearing a tall, slightly bent hat with a feather sticking out. Their hair is not visible under the hat. The clothing is a loose, heavy, and textured coat, with layers suggesting an older style and possibly a cloak or cape draped over one shoulder. They are holding a large stringed instrument with their left arm, which is tucked under their other arm. The background is a simple, textured surface with the artist's signature and the year 1647 visible to the right of the figure.

artworks.title: Study of a Young Man, Seated
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph in black on laid paper

artworks.title: Imaginary View of Venice
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene of a historical European city from an elevated perspective. A prominent dome rises above the rooftops in the distance, alongside a horizon barely visible above rooftops and hills or mountains. The scene is detailed with fine lines in an etching style, giving it a textured appearance. It is primarily monochromatic, with shades of gray and black. There are figures, architectural ruins, dilapidated buildings, canals, and boats navigating waterways. The sky is detailed with lined textures indicating clouds and atmospheric effects.

artworks.title: Rodin
artworks.description: The image shows a man with closed eyes, tilting his head slightly upwards. His face, beard, and part of his chest are visible in a hazy, ethereal manner. The facial features are soft and undefined, with a long beard flowing downwards. The man's hair looks short and loosely arranged. He appears to be not wearing any clothes. The background is a uniform dark shade, emphasizing the man's face and beard, creating a sense of emergence from darkness. No objects or jewelry are visible in the portrait.

artworks.title: Bacchus with Diana and Minerva
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an elephant surrounded by mythical figures and animals. The elephant is draped with garlands of fruit and flowers. On its back is a leopard, accompanied by putti playing a musical instrument. Various mythical creatures are depicted engaging in different activities around the elephant. In the background, there is a landscape with nymph-like figures and tall, spindly plants. The artwork conveys a sense of dynamic movement, detailed ornamentation, and mythical themes characteristic of the Baroque era.

artworks.title: Hercules Killing the Hydra
artworks.artist: Jan Muller after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a muscular male figure in a dynamic pose, raising a club above his head. The man is intricately carved, showing detailed musculature and a focused facial expression. He is in combat with a multi-headed creature that resembles a dragon or serpent, with one of the heads twisting around his body. The creature has multiple heads with sharp features and is entwined around the man. The sculpture appears monochromatic, likely crafted from a material such as bronze or stone.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene. The image shows a thatched barn with animals and figures around a feeding trough where a baby lies. The drawing features intricate details like the straw roof, wooden beams, animals, figures' garments, a tree, and hills in the background. The art looks like an early renaissance woodcut, adding a historical and artistic feel to the scene.

artworks.title: The Crowned Virgin in a Niche
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper mounted on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 21.8 × 10.9 cm (8 9/16 × 4 5/16 in.)
mount: 23.1 × 12.5 cm (9 1/8 × 4 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper three-quarters of a person holding a small child in their left arm. The person wears a crown with a sprouting detail, and their hair is styled with curls or braids. They wear draped robes and hold a staff adorned with a floral pattern in their right hand. In the background, there is a textured pattern and some architectural elements. Text is visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Death of Adonis
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a natural setting. Numerous figures are gathered in a forest-like environment. Some figures attend to a reclining figure, while others show expressions of concern. In the foreground, there is a large tree with dogs standing beside a figure holding a spear. The figures are dressed in classical garments. The background features trees, foliage, and distant hills, indicating an outdoor setting. The lines and shading technique contribute to the composition of the scene, offering depth and texture.

artworks.title: Square in Front of an Inn
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural ruins and natural scenery. The horizon is low, with castle ruins partially obscured by trees and clouds in the sky. People and animals are engaged in various activities amidst lush vegetation and rustic buildings. In the distance, towers and walls of the ruins dominate the view. The style is detailed and intricate, with a monochrome color palette emphasizing lines and shadows for detail and form.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: attributed to Ludwig Büsinck, after Abraham Bloemaert
artworks.medium: color chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the image. In the center, a woman is seated and leaning slightly to the left, cradling a swaddled child. Next to her is a man with a beard, looking at the child. The woman has soft, defined facial features and her hair appears to be styled backward. The man has more rugged facial features with pronounced lines. Both individuals are dressed in flowing garments in brown and black. The child's face is visible with closed eyes and a rounded face. The background has a simple, textured pattern. No jewelry or extraneous objects are visible around them.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Man
artworks.artist: Christoffel van Sichem I after Jacob Matham
artworks.description: The engraving shows a person from the shoulders upwards, in a semi-profile position looking to the right. The person has expressive eyes, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. Their curly hair cascades around the head and shoulders. They wear an ornate headpiece with plumes and decorative motifs, and clothing with a patterned design and embroidered collar. The person holds a piece of cloth or scroll, with their hand partially visible on a ledge. The background is plain with linear shading for depth. An inscription at the bottom reads "I. Matham Inv. I. Eschem scalu" with the date 1613.

artworks.title: Thus the Master Pulls the Cow out of the Well by its Tail
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people observing cattle. A group of individuals, some standing and some seated, are gathered near a tranquil setting with a few cows. The scene is shaded by lush trees and the sky above is dotted with subtle clouds.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: The image shows two figures engaged in an interaction. One figure is seated with legs extended, leaning back on one arm, reaching out with the other to receive an object. The other figure is perched on a rock, leaning slightly forward to offer the object. Both figures have distinct features and are unclothed. In the background, there is a landscape with additional figures, animals, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows three adults and two cherubs. A central seated female figure is draped in robes, with a small child on her lap. An adult male figure stands beside her. One cherub is flying above them, while another is alongside. The background features a pastoral setting with trees and sky.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman holding an infant, with a man standing beside her. The woman has a headscarf and long garment, while the man has a beard and is dressed in a cloak. Two cherubs or angels appear in the background, holding a drapery. The setting includes trees, a landscape, and clouds.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image displays three figures and an angel as the main subjects. The angel, with large wings, stands in the center, reaching up towards palm fronds. Two individuals are portrayed beside the angel, one seated and looking upwards, the other lying down, partially covered, with the third figure facing the viewer. The figures are depicted in classical attire, surrounded by a lush landscape and a sky with clouds.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel and three figures in a pastoral setting. The drawing features a central winged figure standing and gesturing amidst trees. Around the angel, there are three other figures, two sitting and one reclining. Their clothing appears to be flowing and draped, with intricate lines indicating the texture and folds. In the background, there are trees and a suggestion of a natural, serene environment. The composition is detailed with precise line work capturing an ethereal and timeless quality.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image is an etching of three figures seated together. A woman and an older man are shown from the knees up, sitting closely on a blanket under a tree. The woman holds a small child, who appears to be asleep on her lap, wrapped in part of her garment. The older man beside her has a beard and curly hair. He is dressed in loose, flowing robes, with a draped outer garment, and leans slightly towards the woman, his arm wrapped around her. Next to the trio is a donkey grazing on the grass. The background shows a pastoral scene with additional trees, rolling hills, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows figures in a natural setting. There are various people gathered in a lush foliage-filled landscape. In the center, an adult figure holds a child on their lap, while another older figure seems to be conversing nearby. On the left, an angelic figure with wings raises their arms towards a palm tree. The background features detailed depictions of tree branches and clouds in the sky. The image is intricately drawn with fine lines.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows three figures outdoors. In the center, a woman holds an infant in her lap, while a man sits to the right of them near a tree. The background features a landscape with trees and hills, and detailed line work and clouds add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, with a focus on their upper and middle bodies. The person on the left is sitting upright, facing slightly towards the viewer, with their head turned to the side and down, holding a child. This figure has delicate facial features and long hair covered by a shawl. They wear flowing garments. The second person on the right is seated, leaning with their elbow on their knee, holding their head in their hand. The background depicts a natural setting with textured trees, bushes, and hills or mountains. The scene is rendered with fine, detailed lines.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image features an etching of two people shown from head to toe. The figure on the left is a woman seated on the ground, while the other figure, likely a man, also sits on the ground. The woman is looking down at a bundle she holds in her hands. She wears a long dress and styled hair. The man appears to be engaged in reading or examining an object. He has a shaved or closely cropped head and wears a tunic-like garment. The background includes suggestions of trees or foliage.
